ceiling_directive: Prove a complete recovery-or-obstruction theorem for exactly two informative local hazards, including overlapping parent blocks and every positive rank stratum.
improvement_directive: Extend the elimination algebra to exactly two informative hazards: give an explicit interval-state reconstruction for every successful audit pattern and construct glued positive countermodels for every failed pattern, including overlapping-parent and alphabet-sensitive cases.
critique: The delivered necessary-and-sufficient criterion applies only when every hazard except one has no substantive parents; for arbitrary local graphs the note proves only a one-way obstruction. Consequently, the advertised general design problem remains unsettled, and the stated singleton-audit frontier is only the frontier of the restricted single-hazard subclass. The proof handles cancellation of one selection factor but does not resolve interacting hazards, overlapping-parent constraints, alphabet-sensitive bridges, or endpoint-only cancellations. The multinomial delta method and projected confidence set are standard supporting consequences, and the package supplies no worked application or multi-hazard design analysis that would raise this narrow result to the field tier. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.6 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
